subject: AWS Marketplace trial length, procurement snippets, and CTA copy
messages:
From: Jill Thompson <jill.thompson@acme.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-20T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: AWS Marketplace trial length & procurement snippets

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday — the team here liked Redwood's performance numbers. We are starting procurement review for the Marketplace listing and have a few items to confirm before we send this up our legal team: 

1) Trial duration: is the public trial you plan to list on AWS Marketplace fixed at 14 days, or can you offer a configurable trial window (14/30/60) for Private Offers? Our buyers lean toward 30-day trials for enterprise evaluation.

2) Procurement snippet: Can you share short copy we can drop into our internal purchasing docs that clarifies billing (pay-as-you-go via Marketplace), data handling (no customer data retained beyond session unless opted in), and SLA/uptime promises? We only need 2–3 bullet points.

3) CTA text: Our marketplace UX requires a short CTA (12–20 characters) and a longer landing CTA for the offer tile. Could you propose a primary CTA and an alternate for field use?

Attached is the Marketplace draft you shared — we annotated a handful of places. If possible, please send a redline so our procurement/legal can move quickly.

Thanks,
Jill Thompson
Senior Procurement Manager, Acme Corp
Attachments: Redwood_MP_Draft_v3.docx (comments)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Jill Thompson <jill.thompson@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-21T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace trial length & procurement snippets

Hi Jill — great meeting, and really appreciate the quick turnaround from your side. Short answers up front, details below: 

- Public Marketplace listing: default 14-day free trial.
- Private Offer / Private Pricing: can support configurable trial windows (14/30/60) through a Private Offer or seller-managed entitlement.
- Procurement snippet + two CTA options attached.

Action items I'm taking:
- Attach a one-page summary of trial options (see attached trial-options-summary.pdf).
- Draft short procurement bullets and two CTA variants for the tile and the offer page.
- If you want a 30-day public-facing trial we can discuss exceptions but we typically route longer trials via Private Offers for entitlement tracking.

Procurement snippet (short bullets you can paste):
- Billing: Pay-as-you-go via AWS Marketplace; charges appear on buyer AWS bill.
- Data handling: No persistent customer model data retained by Redwood Inference beyond session KV cache. Customer-managed storage and KMS supported for Private deployments.
- Availability & support: Standard Marketplace uptime target 99.5% with optional SLA add-on for dedicated deployments; field-engagement available for onboarding.

CTA proposals: 
- Short tile CTA (12–20 chars): "Start free trial" (primary) / "Request 30-day trial" (alt for Private Offer)
- Offer page CTA (longer): "Start a 14-day free trial — no credit card" / "Request a 30-day enterprise trial"

Attached: trial-options-summary.pdf, aws-listing-cta-matrix.xlsx (tile/offer variants + recommended footnotes).

Let me know if you want us to draft a Private Offer template for 30/60-day trials; Sean can own the pricing & entitlement side.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Marketplace Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Attachments: trial-options-summary.pdf; aws-listing-cta-matrix.xlsx

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-22T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: AWS Marketplace trial length & procurement snippets (coordination)

Team — forwarding Jill's note and my reply. High priority: Acme wants the procurement bullets in a ready-to-paste form for their internal docs and prefers a 30-day enterprise evaluation. Key asks for us: 

- Marissa: can you tighten the procurement bullets for legal friendliness (no hand-wavy terms), include a short evidence line about SOC2 / audit logs if we can say it?
- Sean: can you confirm Private Offer flow and whether we can set 30-day entitlement without extra legal review? If pricing has to change we should note it.
- Irene: any objection to the data-handling line I used? They specifically asked to see language they can include in procurement docs.

Keep it tight — Jill said legal will move quickly if we give clean snippets and a DocuSign-ready Private Offer. I linked the HubSpot deal for reference: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/ACME-1428

Onboarding note: if they take 30-day trial we'll plan a dedicated onboarding call (field) to capture logs and ramp.

Thanks — KP

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-22T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: AWS Marketplace trial length & procurement snippets (coordination)

Kimberly / team — draft procurement copy below; kept it short and conservative. I also added a one-line SOC 2 callout and a suggested footnote for billing transparency. Please review and flag edits.

Procurement-ready bullets (paste into Acme docs):
- Billing: Usage billed via AWS Marketplace (charges appear on buyer’s AWS invoice). No separate invoice from Redwood Inference for Marketplace trials.
- Data handling: Redwood Inference does not persist customer model payloads beyond the active session KV cache; customers may opt into longer-term storage via customer-managed services (S3, KMS).
- Compliance & evidence: Redwood Inference maintains SOC 2 Type II scope for inference services; audit reports available upon request under NDA.
- Support & SLA: Standard Marketplace support for the trial period; upgrade path to Dedicated capacity with SLA add-on for enterprise customers.

CTA suggestions (finalized wording for assets):
- Tile CTA (12–20 chars): "Start free trial"
- Tile CTA (alt): "Request 30-day trial"
- Offer page CTA (long): "Start a 14-day free trial — no credit card" / "Request a 30-day enterprise trial (contact sales)"

Footnote suggestion for the tile: "Trial entitlements and duration may vary by Private Offer; contact sales for enterprise evaluation."

If everyone signs off I can produce a redline of the Marketplace doc and push a Private Offer template for Acme to sign (DocuSign link).

— Marissa
Product Marketing, Redwood Inference

From: Jill Thompson <jill.thompson@acme.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com, Acme Cloud Ops <cloudops@acme.com>
Date: 2027-05-24T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace trial length & procurement snippets

Thanks Kimberly and Marissa — that copy looks good and conservative enough for legal. A couple quick asks before we close: 

- Can you produce a one-page Private Offer template (30-day trial) we can circulate internally? Preferably DocuSign-ready.
- Please include the SOC 2 evidence clause verbatim so legal knows where to request the report.

If you can send the redline and Private Offer template by EOD Tuesday we should be able to route this through procurement next week.

Best,
Jill
Senior Procurement Manager, Acme Corp
Attachments: none
